adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a new fetch call added at line 75 in salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts that refreshes OAuth tokens. This fetch has no timeout configuration, meaning if Salesforce is unresponsive, the call will hang indefinitely. This is a real defect - the code path is new (added by this diff) and lacks timeout handling that would be expected for external API calls. Looking at the diff, the fetch is called during credential initialization in the constructor flow, which could block the entire service construction.
